description: Every infinite almost disjoint family of size less than the bounding number admits another infinite almost disjoint set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.small_almost_disjoint_extension (A : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A) (hi : A.Infinite)
  (hc : Cardinal.mk ↑A < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber) :
  ∃ X, X.Infinite ∧ X ∉ A ∧ ∀ S ∈ A, (S ∩ X).Finite
